china-1912:p0252_3.rationale: Province-by-province list of telegraph station names, corrected to July 1911; it is a textual place list with footnotes on opening and charges, not a statistical series.

china-1912:p0258_1.rationale: Lists of foreign-operated post offices in China by country, including offices in leased territories and Manchuria. This is a text list of offices showing foreign privileges. Postal services is the specific fitting tag; foreign-concessions does not clearly apply to every listed office.
review_questions: Is a tag for foreign postal privileges needed?

china-1912:p0261_1.rationale: Describes three advisory bodies of the Emperor (Inner Cabinet, Grand Council, Cheng Wu Ch'u) in text form.

china-1912:p0265_1.rationale: Text description of the four departments of the Waiwupu (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) and their duties, which concern diplomacy, treaties, passports and foreign interests.

china-1912:p0266_1.rationale: Text description of the fourteen departments of the Ministry of Finance and their duties; the organisational structure is the subject, with finance content in the duties.

china-1912:p0267_1.rationale: Text description of the five departments of the Ministry of Education and their business.

china-1912:p0268_1.rationale: Text list of the ten departments of the Ministry of the Army with their duties; the content concerns army administration.

china-1912:p0268_2.rationale: Text list of the nine departments of the Ministry of the Navy with their duties.

china-1912:p0268_3.rationale: Text list of the nine departments of the Ministry of Laws, covering judicial review, sentences, prisons and judicial appointments.

china-1912:p0269_1.rationale: Text list of departments of the Ministry of the Interior with mixed duties, such as municipal administration, police, surveys and sanitation. No single specific tag fits, so the aggregate government-offices tag is used.
